mapper.select: SELECT id, case_id, order_item_id, quantity, refund_amount FROM after_sale_items WHERE case_id=#{caseId} ORDER BY id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.quantity), 0) FROM after_sale_items item JOIN after_sale_cases sale ON sale.id=item.case_id WHERE item.order_item_id=#{orderItemId} AND sale.status NOT IN ('REJECTED','CLOSED')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(sale.refund_amount), 0) FROM after_sale_cases sale WHERE sale.order_id=#{orderId} AND sale.status NOT IN ('REJECTED','CLOSED')
